decisions.diagnosis: The zeros set missing by zero_outage match the real near-zero riding on a flooded river path during the February 2020 storms.
decisions.evidence: Direction 211 of the same counter recorded 1, 0, 2 on these days (not fixed); the adjacent site 188 (0 km, counter 187) recorded 0 in both directions on 5-9 Feb 2020, then 2-7 per day again from 10 Feb.

decisions.diagnosis: Zero_outage removed a few days of zeros at a site that averages about 4 bikes a day, while the counter kept counting the other direction and the neighbouring site was equally quiet (wet early October 2022).
decisions.evidence: Direction 208 raw was 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1; direction 211 recorded 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1 over the same days; site 188 recorded 0-2 per direction per day.

decisions.diagnosis: The zeros set missing by zero_outage fall in a very quiet spell that is also recorded by direction 208 and the adjacent site, so they are real low riding.
decisions.evidence: Direction 208 recorded 0 on each of 1-7 June 2025 (unfixed); site 188 recorded 0-4 per direction per day; direction 211 had already fallen to 0-5 per day in the second half of May.

decisions.diagnosis: A midnight dump of counts (probably a backlog released after a reset) that cannot be real riding: the day's whole total sits in the first one or two slots.
decisions.evidence: At 00:00 on Sunday 8 June 2025, 208 recorded 121 and 211 recorded 142, plus 6 at 00:15 in 208 and 0 for the rest of the day; the largest slot in six years otherwise is 19 and the 99.9th percentile is 2-3; site 188 recorded 0 that day. The week total becomes 127/143 against 5-26 in nearby weeks.

summary: One Metrocount piezo at the Church St offramp counts very light flows (1-14 bikes/day per direction). It ran from Mar 2019 to Jul 2020 and from Apr 2022 to Jun 2025, with a gap for the light rail works. The automatic zero_outage fixes for April-May 2019 (8 weeks of pure zeros in both directions) stand. Three short zero_outage fixes (Feb 2020 floods, Oct 2022, early Jun 2025) are restored because the other direction and the adjacent site 188 were just as quiet. A spurious midnight dump of 121/142 bikes on 2025-06-08 is set missing.
